localization_policy: Future runtime evidence comes from base source and observed target failures, including bounded source frames; never use gold diff or curator changed-path lists as model inputs.
attempt_policy: New fixed cohort, not reserve promotion. Preserve selection and all failed reviews/reproductions. No model calls until three-cell behavior and environment gates pass. Outcome-driven runtime changes make the affected task development data.
scope: Metadata discovery after observed-frame handoff stabilization. Jinja and Sphinx were previously metadata-collected but not repaired; no human/pretraining unseen claim. New candidate IDs require exposure review before model execution. No independent or official benchmark claim.
